import Lean
def manifest : List (String × String) := [("a", "2"), ("m", "8"), ("z", "1")]
def contract : List (String × String) := [("a", "2"), ("z", "1")]
def solution : List (String × String) := [("a", "2"), ("z", "3")]
def sameValue (left right : String) : Bool :=
  if left == right then true else
    match Lean.Json.parse left, Lean.Json.parse right with
    | .ok a, .ok b => a.compress == b.compress
    | _, _ => false
def compare (left right : List (String × String)) : List String :=
  left.map fun fact =>
    match right.find? (fun candidate => candidate.1 == fact.1) with
    | none => "unresolved"
    | some candidate => if sameValue candidate.2 fact.2 then "matched" else "conflicting"
#eval IO.println (Lean.toJson [compare manifest contract, compare manifest solution, compare contract solution]).compress
